name: @nanoexpress/ultimate
description: Ultimate solution based on nanoexpress and best-practices

scripts.lint: ls-lint && biome check . && oxlint . && rumdl check .
scripts.cleanup: rm -rf cjs/*.js cjs/*.js.map esm/*.js esm/*.js.map typings/
scripts.build: bun run cleanup && bun build ./src/nanoexpress.ts --outdir esm --entry-naming "[name].js" --format esm --target node --packages=external --sourcemap=linked && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --noEmit false --noCheck
scripts.dev: bun run cleanup && bun build ./src/nanoexpress.ts --outdir esm --entry-naming "[name].js" --format esm --target node --packages=external --sourcemap=linked --watch
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build

author: dalisoft
